local count, size = 1, 2
local recover = function(path) return path end
local store = { restore = function(path) return path end }
function store:read(path) return path end

defprotocol Recover do
 def recover(path)
end
defmodule Archive.Store do
 defstruct [:count]
 @callback restore(String.t()) :: String.t()
end
defimpl Recover, for: Archive.Store do
 def recover(path), do: path
end

module Store where
-- | Restore archive contents.
recover :: String -> String
recover path = path
class Restore a where
  restore :: a -> a
instance Restore Int where
  restore x = x
